title: LoomMediaAssetProvenanceAndTemporalSpatialRelations
clause: Restore typed media, asset, provenance, caption, transcript, time and location relations for Loom creative workflows.

current_source_discovery: Inspect stable-main AssetStore, ingestion, captions, transcripts, poster frames, crawler, Atelier and Loom media seams.
Identify canonical asset handles and all derived preview/index/provenance records before editing.
stop_conditions: Raw filesystem paths would become durable authority.
Asset/source ownership or derivative lineage is ambiguous.

scope.summary: Enable Loom to connect crawled image sets, albums, character sheets, training inputs, code and notes through typed asset references, temporal/spatial metadata and provenance while ResourceBroker/owning domains retain authority.
forbidden_paths: Raw absolute path as stable resource identity
CKC or Atelier semantic ownership transfer
acceptance_criteria: Loom relates canonical AssetStore/ResourceBroker handles to blocks and domain sources with content hash, media kind, provenance, derivative lineage and scope.
Caption, transcript, poster-frame, time-range, capture-time and location-derived metadata use typed Surreal records/relations with explicit source and confidence.
Missing, moved, rehashed, deduplicated and regenerated assets reconcile without breaking canonical links or creating duplicate media authority.
Album/folder/tag projections remain attributable to their owning domain and can be rebuilt from canonical sources.
Native media views expose source, derivation, missing/relink and denied-safe states with stable Argus identifiers.
proof_targets: Run real-Surreal media relation and dedup/relink/restart tests with brokered fixture files.
Run time/location/caption/transcript scope and provenance tests.
Run Argus media provenance, missing-source and denied-state captures.

same_project_private_resource_cases: Private images and sensitive time/location metadata remain hidden from unrelated project members.
cross_account_negative_cases: Forged asset handles, hashes or relation IDs fail closed.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Captions, thumbnails, embeddings, albums and training projections cannot widen source scope.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Revocation invalidates previews, cached metadata and open asset handles.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Crawler/cloud metadata is quarantined and explicitly scoped before local relation creation.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Hashes, dimensions, timestamps, coordinates, labels, thumbnails and missing-file errors do not leak denied assets.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: link, ingest, derive, relink, deny and repair events
missing assets, provenance gaps, derivative lag and broker health
media decode/render crash correlation without content leakage

risk_if_missed: Large creative datasets remain disconnected or are linked by brittle paths, preventing safe reuse across CKC, crawlers and training projects.

risks: A moved file breaks every relation.
Loom copies binaries and becomes a second asset authority.
minimum_controls: Brokered stable handles and content hashes.

sources: Official SurrealDB geospatial, relation and index documentation
Stable-main Loom and CKC media audit
research_provenance.selected_approach: Brokered asset identity plus typed provenance and temporal/spatial Surreal relations with repairable projections.
